name: Price tag
description: A price tag slides in; optionally an old price gets struck through first. Use when the speaker says a price or a discount ("$19.99 a week", "was 50, now 20").

value.description: The price exactly as said, in digits: "$19.99"; "20 bucks" becomes "$20".

oldValue.description: Optional old price, shown first and struck through.

text.description: Optional line under the price: "per week", "one time".

name.description: Optional product name above the price.

strikeAt.description: Seconds from the start when the old price is struck.

layout.description: top = card above the head, speaker stays visible. full = covers the frame (speaker hidden).

theme.description: light = warm white card, dark = near-black card, accent = card in the accent colour.

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees. Default -3 for top, 0 for full.

duration.description: Clip length in seconds. Leave out to use the template's own length.

drift.description: Slow push-in over the clip (0 = perfectly still).

region.description: Optional box (frame px, 1080x1920) the content must stay inside; the engine passes the free space above the face.
